member.name: T:MyMath.Operations
member.summary: Provides static methods for performing basic mathematical operations on integers.
member.remarks: The Operations class contains utility methods for working with collections of integers. All methods are static and can be called without creating an instance.

member.name: M:MyMath.Operations.Max(System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Int32})
member.summary: Returns the maximum integer value found in the given list.
member.remarks: This method iterates through the entire list to find the largest integer value. If the list is null or contains no elements, the method returns zero by convention. The method does not modify the original list.
member.param: A list of integers to search. May be null or empty, in which case returns zero.
member.returns: The largest integer in , or zero if the list is null or empty.
